scope: exposed single-response feasibility; three observed target contexts, no pairs, no unseen-context or biological confirmation claim
compound_selection: first 96 lexicographic shared compound names at exact dose/time; fixed before response scoring
panel: existing preparer control-only panel, query vehicles permitted; no treated outcomes choose genes
normalization: per-cell human-gene total to 10000, log2(1+x), equal well means, matched line/plate vehicle subtraction, equal available plates within line
selection: inner full-response gene MSE; finite ties by family ID then penalty; unsupported required fits do not advance
primary: gene mean squared full-response error, equal held compound identities, separate target contexts
spending_filter: candidate at least 5 percent better than locked reference selector in every observed target, positive conditional paired lower bound, better than mean/difference/kernel/alignment controls, no unsupported candidate or required control
checkpoint_policy: retain every inner/final state, attempt, inference bank, scale, basis and prediction; content addressed without pickle
uncertainty: 2000 paired whole-compound resamples coupling all target contexts; exposed-measurement conditional sensitivity, no independent culture or refitting interval
stopping: one finite registered run; no extra doses, ranks, endpoints or seeds after query scores; failures preserve full population with locked-reference fallback and block nomination
